qe: In May 1803 the chief of the Dutch factory at Patna died and his effects were sent to his executors at Chinsura and Falta. Who was that chief?
qh: मई 1803 में पटना की डच फैक्ट्री के प्रमुख का निधन हुआ और उनका सामान उनके निष्पादकों को चिनसुरा तथा फलता भेजा गया। वे प्रमुख कौन थे?
e: Napoleonic yuddh ke dauran English sarkar ne French tatha Dutch ki bharat ki bastiyon ko apne niyantran me le liya tha; isliye 1803 me Patna ki Dutch factory par bhi angreji prabhav tha. May 1803 me Patna ki Dutch factory ke chief Mr. Sohnlein ka nidhan ho gaya; unka saamaan tatha sampatti Patna ke Judge-Magistrate Henry Douglas ne unke executors - Chinsura ke Messrs Bowman tatha Falta ke Ullman - ke paas bhej di. Yah chhota varnan dikhata hai ki us daur me bhi Patna me ek Dutch factory chal rahi thi tatha Dutch adhikari angreji adalat tatha prashasan se sampark me the. Henry Douglas Patna ke Judge-Magistrate 1792 se 6 September 1810 tak rahe tatha 1839 me Patna me hi unka nidhan hua. Exam point: Patna ki Dutch factory ke chief Mr. Sohnlein ka nidhan May 1803 me hua tatha unka saamaan Judge-Magistrate Henry Douglas ne Chinsura tatha Falta ke executors ko bheja; Henry Douglas 1792 se 1810 tak Patna ke Judge-Magistrate rahe.

qe: During the Napoleonic wars, whose control did the Dutch settlements in India pass under, so that they could not be restored at once?
qh: नेपोलियन युद्धों के दौरान भारत में डच बस्तियाँ किसके नियंत्रण में चली गईं, जिसके कारण उन्हें तुरंत वापस नहीं लौटाया गया?
e: Europe me France ke saath yuddh chhidne tatha Holland par French prabhav badhne ke kaaran English sarkar ne socha ki Dutch ki bharat ki bastiyan French ke haath me ja sakti hain. Isliye Governor-General ne apni neetiyan yah maan kar chalin ki France tatha Holland dono ke saath yuddh ho sakta hai tatha Dutch tatha French dono ki bastiyon ko apne niyantran me le liya. Is tarah Dutch ki bharat ki bastiyan, jinme Patna tatha Chinsura jaise sthal shamil the, Napoleonic yuddhon ke ant tak English niyantran me rahin; is daur me Dutch vyaparik gatividhiyan theek se nahi chal paayin. Yahi niyantran aage 1814 ke convention tatha 1824 ke samjhote ki taraf le gaya. Exam point: Napoleonic yuddhon ke dauran French tatha Dutch dono ki bharat ki bastiyan English niyantran me aa gayin; Patna tatha Chinsura jaise Dutch sthal bhi isi niyantran me rahe; yah niyantran yuddh ke ant tak chala aur aage 1814 tatha 1824 ke samjhote bane.

qe: During whose Governor-Generalship were the Dutch possessions of the Moluccas (1810) and Java with its dependencies (August 1811) captured by the British?
qh: किस गवर्नर-जनरल के कार्यकाल में डचों के मोलुक्का द्वीप (1810) तथा जावा एवं उसकी निर्भरता वाले क्षेत्र (अगस्त 1811) अंग्रेजों ने ले लिए?
e: Dutch ki bharat tatha poorv me vyaparik shakti ko todne ke liye angrejon ne unke bade dweep-vyaparik kendron par bhi kabza kiya. Lord Minto ke Governor-Generalship ke dauran 1810 me Moluccas tatha August 1811 me Java tatha uske dependenci yaani aashrit kshetra English sarkar ke adhikar me aa gaye. Java par vijay ke baad October 1811 me Thomas Stamford Raffles ko wahan ka provisional Governor banaya gaya, jinhone aage Bharat ke bahar British vyaparik hiton ko mazboot karne me bada kaam kiya. In vijayon ke kaaran Holland ki purani vyaparik shakti bahut kam ho gayi tatha bharat me Dutch ka prabhav khatm hone laga; aage 1824 ke samjhote me unhone bharat ki sabhi bastiyan British ko de din. Exam point: Lord Minto ke samay Moluccas (1810) tatha Java tatha uske dependenci (August 1811) angrejon ne le liye tatha October 1811 me Raffles ko Java ka provisional Governor banaya gaya; in vijayon se Holland ki vyaparik shakti bahut kam ho gayi.

qe: The Convention of 13 August 1814 between Britain and the Netherlands provided for restoration of the colonies held before the war, but kept which two places in India as exceptions?
qh: 13 अगस्त 1814 के ब्रिटेन-नीदरलैंड समझौते ने युद्ध से पहले के उपनिवेश लौटाने का प्रावधान किया, पर भारत में किन दो स्थानों को अपवाद रखा?
e: Napoleonic yuddh ke ant me 13 August 1814 ko Britain tatha Netherlands ke beech ek samjhauta hua, jisme tay hua ki Holland ke woh sabhi upnivesh tatha bastiyan lautai jayengi, jo uske paas Europe ke is yuddh se pehle yaani 1794-95 se pehle the. Is samjhauta me kuch sthalon ko apwaad yaani exception banaya gaya, jisme bharat me Cochin tatha Baranagore shamil the. Baaki Dutch bastiyon ko wapas dene ke liye Mr. F. A. Van Braam ko Chinsura ka Commissioner banaya gaya; unhone 1817 me Mr. Cassiarees Regal ko Patna tatha Dacca ki Dutch bastiyon ka charge lene ke liye bheja tatha agle saal tak Dutch ko bharat me apni lagbhag saari sampatti wapas mil gayi. Lekin yah sthiti zyada din nahi chali tatha 1824-25 me Dutch ne sabhi establishments British ko saunp diye. Exam point: 13 August 1814 ke samjhauta me Holland ko uske yuddh-purv upnivesh lautaane ka prastav tha, lekin bharat me Cochin tatha Baranagore ko apwaad rakha gaya; Van Braam Chinsura ka Commissioner bane tatha 1817 me Cassiarees Regal Patna tatha Dacca ka charge lene bheje gaye.

qe: On 17 March 1824 a treaty was signed at London between Britain and the Netherlands. What did the Netherlands do under its 8th article?
qh: 17 मार्च 1824 को लंदन में ब्रिटेन तथा नीदरलैंड के बीच संधि हुई। इसके 8वें अनुच्छेद में नीदरलैंड ने क्या किया?
oe: Ceded all its establishments on the continent of India and renounced their privileges
Gave up the trade of saltpetre in Bihar
Transferred Malacca to the British Crown
oh: भारत महाद्वीप की अपनी सभी बस्तियाँ ब्रिटेन को सौंप दीं तथा उनके विशेषाधिकार त्याग दिए
बिहार का शोरा व्यापार छोड़ दिया
मलक्का ब्रिटिश ताज को हस्तांतरित किया
e: Bharat me Dutch shakti ko antim roop se samapt karne wali sandhi 17 March 1824 ko London me British Government tatha Netherlands ki sarkar ke beech hui. Iske aathven anuchhed (Article 8) me Netherlands ke raja ne Bharat mahadweep ki apni sabhi establishments tatha bastiyan British ko saunp din tatha unke aadhaar par jo visheshadhikar yaani exemptions unhe prapt the, unhe tyaag diya. Isi samjhote me Malacca tatha uske dependenci Britain ko diye gaye, Sumatra ke English possessions tatha Fort Marlborough Netherlands ko diye gaye tatha Singapore par British adhikar ko Netherlands ne svast kiya. Sabhi possessions ki delivery 1 March 1825 ko poori honi thi. Iske baad Bihar tatha Bangal me Dutch ka poora vyaparik prabhav khatm ho gaya. Exam point: 17 March 1824 ki London sandhi ke 8ve anuchhed me Netherlands ne Bharat mahadweep ki sabhi bastiyan British ko saunpin tatha visheshadhikar chhod diye; isi samjhote me Malacca Britain ko tatha Sumatra Netherlands ko diya gaya; delivery 1 March 1825 ko poori hui.

qe: Under the treaty of March 1824, delivery of all the exchanged possessions was to be made by which date?
qh: मार्च 1824 की संधि के अनुसार सभी अदल-बदल की गई बस्तियों की सुपुर्दगी किस तारीख तक की जानी थी?
e: 17 March 1824 ko London me hui British-Netherlands sandhi me Bharat tatha poorvi kshetra ki bastiyon ka aapas me adal-badal tay hua. Is sandhi ke anuchhed 13 me tay hua ki sabhi possessions ki delivery 1 March 1825 tak kar di jayegi. Isi kram me Dutch ki Chinsura, Patna tatha Dacca jaise sthalon par se unka adhikar khatm hua tatha woh British sarkar ke poore niyantran me aa gaye. Sandhi ke ek anya anuchhed me yah bhi tay hua tha ki sandhi ki suchna ke baad chhah saal tak wahan ke nivasi apni sampatti apni marzi se bech sakte the. Aise prabandh dikhate hain ki upniveshiy satta ke badlav me bhi aam logon tatha vyapariyon ko kuch samay ki rahat di jaati thi. Exam point: 17 March 1824 ki sandhi me tay hua ki sabhi possessions ki delivery 1 March 1825 tak poori honi thi; Dutch bastiyon par British adhikar isi kram me pakka hua; sandhi me nivasiyon ko chhah saal tak sampatti bechne tatha sambhaalne ki chhoot di gayi thi.

qe: Which place was transferred to the British Crown under the treaty of 1824, while the English possessions in Sumatra were ceded to the Netherlands?
qh: 1824 की संधि के अंतर्गत कौन-सा स्थान ब्रिटिश ताज को दिया गया, जबकि सुमात्रा में अंग्रेजों की बस्तियाँ नीदरलैंड को सौंपी गईं?
e: 1824 ki London sandhi me Britain tatha Netherlands ne apne-apne vyaparik kshetra aapas me badle. Iske 9ve anuchhed me Fort Marlborough tatha Sumatra dweep ke sabhi English possessions Netherlands ko diye gaye tatha Britain ne yah vada kiya ki woh Sumatra par koi nayi basti nahi banayega aur na wahan ke rajaon se koi sandhi karega. 10ve anuchhed me Malacca nagar tatha uska bandargah tatha uske dependenci British Crown ko diye gaye. 12ve anuchhed me Netherlands ne Singapore par British adhikar par apni aapatti wapas le li. Is tarah ek sandhi me Bharat, Malacca tatha Sumatra ke kshetraon ka poora adal-badal hua tatha angrejon tatha Dutch ke beech puraane jhagde khatm ho gaye. Exam point: 1824 ki sandhi me Malacca tatha uska bandargah British Crown ko diya gaya; Fort Marlborough tatha Sumatra ke English possessions Netherlands ko mile tatha Britain ne Sumatra par nayi basti na banane ka vada kiya; Singapore par Netherlands ne apni aapatti wapas li.

qe: In 1817 which officer was deputed by the Dutch Commissioner at Chinsura to receive charge of the Dutch establishments at Patna and Dacca?
qh: 1817 में चिनसुरा के डच कमिश्नर ने पटना तथा ढाका की डच बस्तियों का प्रभार लेने के लिए किस अफसर को नियुक्त किया?
e: 1814 ke samjhote ke baad Holland ko uski purani bastiyan lautane ka kram shuru hua tatha Mr. F. A. Van Braam ko Chinsura ka Commissioner banaya gaya, jinka kaam Netherlands ke raja ki bharat ki bastiyon ko wapas apne kabze me lena tha. Van Braam ne 1817 me Mr. Cassiarees Regal ko is kaam ke liye niyukt kiya ki woh Patna tatha Dacca ki Dutch establishments ka charge lein. Agle saal tak Dutch ko unki lagbhag saari bharat ki sampatti wapas mil gayi. Isse pata chalta hai ki 1814 tatha 1824 ke samjhote ke beech kuch saal ke liye Dutch log Patna jaise sthalon par phir se aaye tatha unhone apna vyaparik kaam dobara shuru karne ki koshish ki; lekin yah sthiti zyada din nahi chali. Exam point: Van Braam Chinsura ka Commissioner bane tatha 1817 me unhone Mr. Cassiarees Regal ko Patna tatha Dacca ki Dutch bastiyon ka charge lene ke liye niyukt kiya; agle saal tak Dutch ko unki bharat ki sampatti wapas mil gayi; yah sthiti 1824-25 ke samjhote tak hi chali.

qe: India's second oil refinery, set up at Barauni in 1964 and now run by Indian Oil Corporation, is located in which district of Bihar?
qh: 1964 में बरौनी में स्थापित, भारत की दूसरी तेल रिफाइनरी, जिसे अब इंडियन ऑयल कॉरपोरेशन चलाता है, बिहार के किस जिले में है?
e: Barauni Tel Riphainari (Barauni Oil Refinery) Begusarai jile me Ganga nadi ke kinare sthit hai; ise 1964 me shuru kiya gaya tha tatha yah bharat ki doosri tel riphainari maani jaati hai (pehli Digboi, Assam me thi). Shuruaat me iska nirmaan Soviet Union ke sahayog se hua tatha iska mukhya uddeshya Assam tatha anya kshetraon se aane wale crude oil ko saaf kar ke petrol, diesel, kerosene tatha LPG banana tha. Aaj yah Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) dwara sanchalit hoti hai tatha iski capacity samay-samay par badhayi gayi hai; isi complex ke paas Barauni Thermal Power Station bhi hai, isliye Begusarai ko Bihar ka mukhya udyog-kendra kaha jaata hai. Barauni se nikalne wale petroleum products ka vitaran pipeline tatha rail-sadak ke zariye uttar bharat ke kai rajyon me hota hai. Patna, Buxar tatha Bhagalpur me aisi oil refinery nahi hai, isliye Begusarai hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Barauni Oil Refinery = Begusarai jila, 1964 me sthapit, bharat ki doosri refinery, Soviet sahayog se shuru; aaj IOCL dwara sanchalit.

qe: Which fertiliser plant, revived as a joint venture of four public sector companies and dedicated to the nation in 2022, is located at Barauni?
qh: चार सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र की कंपनियों के संयुक्त उपक्रम के रूप में पुनर्जीवित तथा 2022 में राष्ट्र को समर्पित कौन-सा उर्वरक संयंत्र बरौनी में स्थित है?
oe: Hindustan Urvarak and Rasayan Limited (HURL) urea plant
oh: हिंदुस्तान उर्वरक एवं रसायन लिमिटेड (HURL) का यूरिया संयंत्र
e: Barauni me pehle ek urvarak (fertiliser) factory thi, jise 1960 ke dashak me shuru kiya gaya tha, lekin kachche maal (gas) ki kami tatha aarthik dikkaton ke kaaran 2003 ke aas-paas band kar diya gaya. Azaad bharat me urvarak ki badhti maang ko dekhte hue kendriya sarkar ne Hindustan Urvarak and Rasayan Limited (HURL) naam ki company banai, jisme chaar sarkari company - NTPC, Coal India, Indian Oil tatha FCIL - saajhedar (joint venture) hain. HURL ne Barauni (Bihar), Sindri (Jharkhand) tatha Gorakhpur (Uttar Pradesh) me purane planton ko naye tareeke se khada kiya; Barauni ka naya urea plant 2022 me rashtra ko samarpit kiya gaya. Is plant me natural gas se ammonia banta hai aur ammonia tatha carbon dioxide se urea; urea kheti ki sabse zyada istemal hone wali khad hai, isliye yah Bihar ke kisano ke liye bahut mahatvapurn hai. Sindri, Talcher tatha Gorakhpur anya rajyon ke plant hain, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi. Exam point: Barauni ka urea plant = HURL (NTPC, Coal India, Indian Oil tatha FCIL ka joint venture), 2022 me rashtra ko samarpit; purana plant 2003 me band hua tha.

qe: Which town in Bihar is famous as the 'Silk City' and has a GI-tagged silk product?
qh: बिहार का कौन-सा शहर 'सिल्क सिटी' के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है तथा उसका रेशम उत्पाद जीआई टैग प्राप्त है?
e: Bhagalpur ko Bihar ka 'Silk City' kaha jaata hai; yahan ki silk (resham) weaving ki parampara sadiyon purani hai tatha 'Bhagalpur silk' ko GI (Geographical Indication) tag bhi mila hai. Yahan ka prasiddh tussar silk apne naturel chamak (lustre) tatha pairon ke bunai ke liye duniya bhar me jaana jaata hai, kyunki isme zyada resham tatha kam twist hota hai. Silk ke saath-saath Bhagalpur jila apne 'Zardalu' aam ke liye bhi prasiddh hai, jise 2018 me GI tag mila. Silk udyog me yahan hazaron bunakar (weaver) parivar kaam karte hain, isliye yah udyog Bihar ki aarthik pehchan ka hissa hai. Gaya tilkut tatha pitrapaksha mela ke liye, Muzaffarpur Shahi Litchi ke liye tatha Champaran-Jute kshetra alag mahatva rakhte hain; isliye 'Bhagalpur' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: 'Silk City of Bihar' = Bhagalpur; Bhagalpur silk ko GI tag mila hai tatha yah tussar silk ke liye prasiddh hai; Bhagalpur ka Zardalu aam bhi GI product.

qe: Purnea district hosts India's first grain-based ethanol plant based on maize; which policy of Bihar promotes ethanol production from grain?
qh: पूर्णिया जिले में मक्का पर आधारित भारत का पहला ग्रेन-आधारित एथेनॉल संयंत्र है; बिहार की कौन-सी नीति अनाज से एथेनॉल उत्पादन को बढ़ावा देती है?
e: Ethanol ek aisa alakahol hai jise petrol me mila kar (blending) fuels ka istemal hota hai; yah ganne ke ras, molasses, tatha anaj (jaise makka, toota chawal) se banaya jaata hai. Purnea jile me Bihar ki 'Ethanol Production Promotion Policy' ke tehat desh ka pehla grain-based (anaj-adharit) ethanol plant makke par khada kiya gaya tatha in dino yah kshetra ethanol utpadan ka bada hub ban raha hai. Is fasal ka laabh yah hai ki Bihar ke Kosi-Seemanchal kshetra me makka bahut hota hai; Katihar, Purnea tatha Khagaria makka utpadan me state me aage hain, isliye kinare-kinare khet me se nikalne wale anaj ka seedha bazaar ban jaata hai. Ethanol se kisan ki aay badhti hai, petrol ke aayaton par nirbharta kam hoti hai tatha paryavaran ke liye faayda hota hai, kyunki ethanol ke jalan se kam pradushan hota hai. Textile tatha food processing policies anya kshetraon ke liye hain, isliye sahi uttar 'Ethanol Production Promotion Policy' hai. Exam point: Purnea = bharat ka pehla grain-based ethanol plant (makka), Bihar Ethanol Production Promotion Policy se protsahit; Kosi-Seemanchal (Katihar, Purnea, Khagaria) makka ka mukhya kshetra.

qe: Which district of Bihar is the largest producer of jute, and which jute park is located there?
qh: बिहार का सबसे बड़ा जूट उत्पादक जिला कौन है तथा वहाँ कौन-सा जूट पार्क स्थित है?
e: Jute (patson) ko 'sunehri resha' (golden fibre) bhi kaha jaata hai kyunki iska rang sunehra hota hai tatha yah boree, dor, dari tatha packaging ke liye kaam aata hai. Bihar me jute ke utpadan me Purnea jila sabse aage hai; isi kshetra me Maranga (Purnea) me 'Jute Park' vikasit kiya gaya, jahan jute se alag-alag utpad banane tatha unhe bechne ki suvidha di jaati hai. Jute ki kheti ko garam, nami wala mausam tatha achhi barsaat chahiye hoti hai, isliye yah Kosi-Seemanchal kshetra (Purnea, Katihar, Araria) ki mahatvapurn nakit (cash) fasal hai; Katihar me per hectare utpadan (productivity) achha rehta hai tatha wahan jute mills bhi hain. Jute utpadan me West Bengal desh me pehle sthan par hai tatha Bihar bhi jute utpadak rajyon me ginta hai. Katihar, Saharsa tatha Darbhanga ke diye gaye park-naam galat hain, isliye 'Purnea, Maranga Jute Park' hi sahi jodi hai. Exam point: jute (sunehri resha) utpadan me Bihar me pratham jila = Purnea tatha Maranga (Purnea) Jute Park sthit hai; jute utpadan me West Bengal desh me pehle sthan par hai.

qe: Mokama tal in Patna district, famous for which crop's processing cluster, is a leading centre of dal mills?
qh: पटना जिले का मोकामा ताल, जो एक प्रसंस्करण (processing) क्लस्टर तथा दाल मिलों का प्रमुख केंद्र है, किस फसल के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Mokama tal Patna jile me Ganga nadi ke kinare faila hua nicha kshetra hai, jahan barsaat ke baad nami bachi rehti hai tatha rabi ki fasal achhi hoti hai. Yah kshetra masoor (lentil) ke utpadan me Bihar me sabse aage hai; isi ke saath Barahiya tal bhi juda hai, jisse 'Mokama-Barahiya dal belt' kaha jaata hai. Masoor ek dalhan (pulse) hai jisme protein adhik hota hai tatha yah duniya me sabse zyada paayi jaane wali dalon me se ek hai. Isi kshetra me bahut si dal mills sthit hain, jahan masoor ki dal banai tatha pack ki jaati hai; isi wajah se Mokama dal-mill cluster ke liye poore desh me jaana jaata hai. Arhar, ganna tatha jute bhi Bihar ki mahatvapurn fasalein hain, lekin Mokama ka naam masoor ke liye prasiddh hai. Exam point: Mokama tal (Patna) = masoor (lentil) ka bharat-prasiddh kshetra, Mokama-Barahiya dal processing cluster; masoor rabi ki mukhya dalhan fasal hai.

qe: 'Shahi Litchi', the famous GI-tagged litchi of Bihar, belongs to which district?
qh: बिहार का जीआई टैग पाने वाला पहला कृषि उत्पाद 'शाही लीची' किस जिले का है?
e: GI tag ka poora naam 'Geographical Indication' hai; iska arth hai kisi vastu ke naam ke saath uske bhoogolik kshetra ka vishesh rishta jod dena, jisse us kshetra ke utpadakon ko vishesh adhikar milta hai tatha nakli utpadon se bachav hota hai. Muzaffarpur ki 'Shahi Litchi' ko 2018 me GI tag mila, isliye yah Bihar ke prasiddh krishi-utpadon me gina jaata hai; Muzaffarpur me litchi ki kheti ke liye Bal-Sundari (Bangar/Doammat) mitti tatha anukool mausam achha milta hai. Iske alava Bihar ke anya GI utpad hain - Bhagalpur ka Zardalu aam, Katarni chawal, Magahi paan tatha Silao ka khaja; yah sab kshetra-vishesh utpad hain. Darbhanga makhana tatha Mithila makhana GI ke liye, Bhagalpur silk tatha Zardalu aam ke liye tatha Nalanda amrood-pyaz ke liye jaana jaata hai, lekin Shahi Litchi Muzaffarpur ka naam hai. Isliye 'Muzaffarpur' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Shahi Litchi (GI) = Muzaffarpur; Bihar ke anya GI - Zardalu aam (Bhagalpur), Katarni chawal, Magahi paan, Silao khaja, Madhubani painting, Bhagalpur silk tatha Mithila makhana.

qe: Which district of Bihar is the leading producer of banana and also the leading producer of maize in the state?
qh: बिहार में केला (banana) का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक तथा मक्का का अग्रणी उत्पादक जिला कौन-सा है?
e: Katihar jila Bihar me kela (banana) ka sabse bada utpadak hai tatha makka ke utpadan me bhi state ke top jilon me aata hai; isi ke saath Purnea tatha Khagaria makka me aage hain. Kela ek aisi fasal hai jise tissue-culture (laboratory me taiyar kiye gaye paudhon) se ugaya jaata hai; isme G-9 kism prasiddh hai tatha Katihar-Purnea kshetra iski productivity me sabse aage hai. Bihar ka 'Chiniya kela' Hajipur (Vaishali) ke liye prasiddh hai, lekin kul utpadan me Katihar pehle sthan par hai. Makka ka mahatva isliye bhi badha hai kyunki Purnea me us par desh ka pehla grain-based ethanol plant khada kiya gaya, jisse Kosi-Seemanchal ke kisano ko naya bazaar mila. Rohtas dhan tatha gehun ka, Gaya tilkut-til ka, tatha Saran jile ka sambandh ganne tatha pashu melon se zyada hai; isliye Katihar hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: kela me pratham jila = Katihar (G-9 tissue-culture kela), makka me agrani jile = Katihar, Purnea tatha Khagaria; Chiniya kela = Hajipur (Vaishali).

qe: In which district is the 'Centre of Excellence for Fruits', which works on guava and other horticulture crops, located?
qh: अमरूद तथा अन्य बागवानी फसलों पर काम करने वाला 'सेंटर ऑफ एक्सीलेंस फॉर फ्रूट्स' किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Nalanda jile me 'Centre of Excellence for Fruits' (phalon ke liye utkrishtata kendra) sthit hai, jahan amrood (guava) tatha anya phalon ki unnat kismein, grafting, drip sinchai tatha post-harvest processing par kaam hota hai. Bihar me Nalanda amrood utpadan me pehle sthan par hai tatha pyaz, aalu tatha baingan jaisi sabziyon me bhi aage aata hai; isi kshetra me Bihar Sharif ke paas ye kendra kisano ko achhi kism ke paudhe tatha training deta hai. Aise 'Centre of Excellence' kendra kisi kshetra ki khaas fasal ke liye vaigyanik sahayog dete hain - jaise Muzaffarpur me litchi tatha West Champaran me ganne ke liye kaam hota hai, lekin prashn me poochha gaya kendra Nalanda me hai. Bhagalpur silk tatha Zardalu aam ke liye tatha Muzaffarpur Shahi Litchi ke liye jaana jaata hai, isliye 'Nalanda' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Centre of Excellence for Fruits = Nalanda jila (amrood tatha anya phal); Nalanda amrood, pyaz tatha aalu me agrani jila; Muzaffarpur litchi tatha West Champaran ganne ke liye prasiddh.

qe: The international airport of Patna is named after which freedom fighter and socialist leader of Bihar?
qh: पटना का अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा बिहार के किस स्वतंत्रता सेनानी तथा समाजवादी नेता के नाम पर है?
e: Patna ka hawaai adda 'Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport' ke naam se jaana jaata hai; yah Patna ke aas-paas sthit Bihar ka sabse vyast hawaai adda hai. Jayaprakash Narayan (JP) ne 1974 me Bihar se 'Sampoorna Kranti' aandolan chalaun tatha aapatkal ke dauran jail gaye; unhe 1999 me marnoparat Bharat Ratna mila. Kisi bhi kshetra ka naam wahan ki sabse badi sansthaon me dikhta hai, isliye unnati ke saath-saath smriti ka yeh jodna ban gaya hai - Patna me Ganga par bana bada pul 'Mahatma Gandhi Setu' kahlata hai tatha hawaai adda JP ke naam par hai. Dr. Rajendra Prasad bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati tatha Dr. Sri Krishna Singh Bihar ke pehle Mukhyamantri the tatha Karpoori Thakur 'Jan Nayak' kehlate hain, lekin Patna ke hawaai adda ka naam JP ke naam par hai. Isliye sahi uttar Jayaprakash Narayan hai. Exam point: Patna ka hawaai adda = Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport; JP ne 1974 me Sampoorna Kranti ka netritva kiya tatha 1999 me unhe marnoparat Bharat Ratna mila; Patna me Ganga par Mahatma Gandhi Setu hai.

qe: Which airport of Bihar, located near Bodh Gaya, handles international flights bringing Buddhist pilgrims from Thailand, Myanmar and Sri Lanka?
qh: बोधगया के निकट स्थित बिहार का कौन-सा हवाई अड्डा थाईलैंड, म्यांमार तथा श्रीलंका से आने वाले बौद्ध तीर्थयात्रियों की अंतर्राष्ट्रीय उड़ानों की सुविधा देता है?
e: Gaya International Airport ko Bodh Gaya ke nikat hone ke karan log 'Bodh Gaya Airport' bhi kehte hain; yah bharat ke una hawaai addon me hai jahan se antarrashtriya udane chalti hain. Bodh Gaya me Mahabodhi mandir (UNESCO World Heritage Site) sthit hai, isliye Thailand, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, Japan tatha anya deshon ke Buddhist yatri yahin pahunchte hain; isi maang ko dekhte hue Gaya se unke deshon ke liye vishesh udane chalti hain. Yah Bihar ka ek mahatvapurn paryatan-dwar hai tatha dharmik yatra ke saath-saath yah kshetra paryatan tatha sthaniya rozgaar ke liye bhi faaydemand hai, kyunki yatri hotel tatha anya suvidhaon ka istemal karte hain. Darbhanga tatha Patna ke hawaai adda mukhya roop se gharelu udanon ke liye jaane jaate hain, tatha Purnea me koi bada antarrashtriya hawaai adda nahi hai, isliye sahi uttar Gaya International Airport hai. Exam point: Gaya International Airport = Bodh Gaya ke nikat, Buddhist yatriyon ki antarrashtriya udanon ke liye; Mahabodhi mandir (UNESCO 2002) Bodh Gaya (Gaya jila) me sthit hai.

qe: Darbhanga Airport, which began commercial flights under the UDAN scheme in 2020, operates as a civil enclave at:
qh: 2020 में उड़ान योजना के तहत वाणिज्यिक उड़ानें शुरू करने वाला दरभंगा हवाई अड्डा किसके नागरिक परिक्षेत्र (civil enclave) के रूप में संचालित होता है?
e: Darbhanga Airport ek 'civil enclave' ke roop me chalta hai, yaani yah ek vayusena (Air Force) station ke andar alag kshetra me bana hua nagarik hawaai adda hai; isi tarah ke arrangements Patna tatha anya shahron me bhi dekhe jaate hain. 2020 me 'UDAN' yojana ke tehat yahan se Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru tatha anya shahron ke liye gharelu udane shuru hui. 'UDAN' ka poora naam 'Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik' hai; is yojana ka uddeshya yah hai ki chhote shahron ke log sasti tatha niyamit hawai yatra kar sakein, taaki vikas tatha vyapar ko gati mile. Darbhanga kshetra Mithilanchal ka mukhya kendra hai, isliye yahan se udanon ka chalna makhana, litchi tatha anya utpadon ke vyapariyon tatha bharat ke anya hisson me kaam karne wale logon ke liye bada laabh hai. Navy base, BSF camp tatha railway colony kisi hawaai adda ke civil enclave nahi hote, isliye sahi uttar vayusena station hai. Exam point: Darbhanga Airport = vayusena station ka civil enclave, 2020 me UDAN ke tehat vyaavsayik udane shuru; UDAN ka arth 'Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik' tatha iska uddeshya chhote shahron ko hawai suvidha dena hai.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi Setu, one of the longest river bridges of India, connects Patna with which town across the Ganga?
qh: भारत के सबसे लंबे नदी-पुलों में एक महात्मा गांधी सेतु पटना को गंगा पार किस नगर से जोड़ता है?
e: Mahatma Gandhi Setu Ganga nadi par bana ek vishal pul hai jo Patna ko Hajipur (Vaishali jila) se jodta hai; ise 1982 me rashtra ko samarpit kiya gaya tatha kai saal tak yah bharat ka sabse lamba nadi-pul maana jaata raha. Iski lambai lagbhag 5.5 kilometre se adhik hai tatha yah khambhon par khadi 'cable-stayed/cantilever' jaisi design par bana hua hai; aane-jaane ke liye yah uttar Bihar tatha Patna ke beech sabse mahatvapurn rasta hai, isliye yahan hamesha bheed rehti hai. Iske alava Ganga par Bihar me Vikramshila Setu (Bhagalpur) tatha anya pul bhi hain, lekin Patna-Hajipur jodne wala pul Mahatma Gandhi Setu hai. Muzaffarpur tatha Chhapra Patna ke uttar-pashchim me sthit shahar hain jahan tak sadak aur rail se pahuncha jaata hai, tatha Sonepur Ganga-Gandak sangam ka kshetra hai - isliye sahi uttar Hajipur hai. Exam point: Mahatma Gandhi Setu = Ganga par Patna-Hajipur ko jodne wala pul (1982 me samarpit), kai saal tak Bharat ka sabse lamba nadi-pul; Vikramshila Setu = Bhagalpur me Ganga par.

qe: Vikramshila Setu, a bridge over the Ganga, is located in which town of Bihar?
qh: गंगा पर बना विक्रमशिला सेतु बिहार के किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: Vikramshila Setu Ganga nadi par bana ek lamba sadak-pul hai jo Bhagalpur shahar ko Ganga ke jo Bhagalpur ko Ganga ke uttari kinare se jodta hai tatha shehar ke andar aane-jaane ko aasan banata hai. Iska naam prachin Vikramshila Mahavihara ke naam par pada hai, jo Bhagalpur jile ke Antichak me sthit tha tatha Pala shasak Dharmapala dwara sthapit Vajrayana buddh dharm ka bada kendra tha. Bhagalpur kshetra Ganga ke kinare basa hone ke kaaran pehle nauka tatha boat se aana-jaana hota tha, pul banne ke baad vyapar tatha rozgaar me badhotri hui. Munger me bhi Ganga par pul hai tatha wahan Munger kila sthit hai, Begusarai me Barauni ka udyog-kshetra tatha Buxar me Chausa tatha Buxar ke yuddh-sthal hain - isliye Vikramshila Setu ke liye Bhagalpur hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Vikramshila Setu = Bhagalpur me Ganga par bana pul; naam prachin Vikramshila Mahavihara (Antichak, Bhagalpur) se aaya, jo Dharmapala dwara sthapit tha; Munger me Ganga par alag pul tatha Munger kila hai.

qe: The headquarters of the East Central Railway zone, one of the largest railway zones of India, is located at:
qh: भारत के सबसे बड़े रेलवे ज़ोन में एक पूर्व मध्य रेलवे का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: East Central Railway (ECR) zone ka mukhyalay Hajipur (Vaishali jila) me sthit hai; is zonal kshetra me Bihar tatha padosi rajyon ke kai division aate hain, jaise Danapur, Mughalsarai (Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyaya), Dhanbad, Samastipur tatha Sonpur. Hajipur ko isliye mahatvapurn mana jaata hai kyunki yah Ganga ke uttar kinare par Patna ke bilkul saamne basa hai; Mahatma Gandhi Setu tatha rail pul se yah Patna se juda hai, isliye yahan rail tatha sadak dono ka bada junction ban gaya. Bihar me rail ke vikas ka itihas bahut purana hai tatha Patna ke paas Danapur tatha Sonpur railway ke bade kendra hain, jahan loco tatha workshop ki suvidhaayein hain; isi tarah Saran jile ke Bela me rail-wheel plant bhi sthit hai. Patna, Muzaffarpur tatha Darbhanga bade rail junctions hain, lekin ECR ka mukhyalay Hajipur me hai, isliye sahi uttar Hajipur hai. Exam point: East Central Railway ka mukhyalay = Hajipur (Vaishali); iske pramukh division Danapur, DDU (Mughalsarai), Dhanbad, Samastipur tatha Sonpur hain; Hajipur Patna ke saamne Ganga ke uttar kinare par hai.

qe: The Rail Wheel Plant of Indian Railways, which manufactures wheels for trains, is located at Bela in which district of Bihar?
qh: ट्रेनों के पहिये बनाने वाला भारतीय रेल का रेल व्हील प्लांट बेला में बिहार के किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Bharatiya Rail ka 'Rail Wheel Plant' Bela me sthit hai, jo Saran jile me Ganga ke kinare ke paas pada gaon hai; yah plant rail-coach tatha wagon ke liye loha ke pahiye (wheels) banata hai. Bela ka chunav isliye hua kyunki yah Ganga ke kinare tatha rail-sadak network ke paas hai, jisse kachcha maal (scrap/steel) aana tatha bane pahiye desh bhar bhejna aasan hota hai; isi kshetra me Dighwara tatha Sonepur bhi mahatvapurn rail-sadak kendra hain. Saran jila apne itihas tatha krishi ke liye bhi jaana jaata hai tatha yah Ganga-Gandak tatha Ghaghra ke sangam-kshetra se juda hai. Vaishali (Hajipur), Bhojpur tatha Nalanda anya mahatvapurn jile hain, lekin Rail Wheel Plant Bela Saran me hai, isliye sahi uttar Saran hai. Exam point: Rail Wheel Plant, Bela = Saran jila (Ganga ke kinare, Dighwara-Sonepur kshetra ke paas); yah bharatiya rail ke pahiyon ki utpadan ikai hai tatha rail-network ki sahayak hai.

qe: The bridge over the Sone river at Koilwar, known as Abdul Bari Bridge, is associated with which district?
qh: सोन नदी पर कोइलवर में बना पुल, जिसे अब्दुल बारी पुल कहा जाता है, किस जिले से जुड़ा है?
e: Sone nadi par Koilwar ke paas bana rail-cum-road pul 'Abdul Bari Bridge' ke naam se jaana jaata hai; yah Bhojpur (Ara) jile ke Koilwar kshetra me hai tatha yah Bihar ke sabse puraane bade pulon me ginta hai. Uss samay is pul ko sirf rail ke liye banaya gaya tha tatha yah Patna-Ara ke rasta ka mahatvapurn hissa bana; baad me iske paas naya road pul bhi ban gaya. Sone Ganga ki dayen tat ki pramukh sahayak nadi hai jo Kaimur-Rohtas kshetra se nikal kar Patna ke paas Ganga me milti hai, isliye iske pul kshetra ke logon ke liye aana-jaana tatha vyapar bahut aasan ho jaata hai. Patna, Rohtas tatha Buxar jile bhi Sone-Ganga ke kshetra se jude hain, lekin Koilwar ka pul Bhojpur jile me hai, isliye sahi uttar Bhojpur hai. Exam point: Sone nadi par Koilwar ka pul = Abdul Bari Bridge, Bhojpur jila; Sone nadi Ganga ki dayen tat ki sahayak hai jo Kaimur-Rohtas se nikal kar Patna ke nikat Ganga me milti hai.

qe: Into how many broadly marked agricultural tracts was the district divided, the first three falling in the Bankipore, Barh and Dinapore subdivisions and the fourth consisting of the Bihar subdivision?
qh: जिला कितने स्पष्ट रूप से अलग-अलग कृषि-क्षेत्रों में बाँटा गया था, जिनमें पहले तीन बाँकीपुर, बाढ़ तथा दानापुर अनुमंडलों में पड़ते थे और चौथा बिहार अनुमंडल को मिलाकर बना था?
e: Jile ko krishi ki drishti se char spasht kshetron yaani tracts me baanta gaya tha. Pehla - Ganga ke pattal me bani diara bhoomi, jo poore uttar ki or phaili hai; doosra - Ganga ke sthayi kinare tatha dakshin ki nichli bhoomi ke beech ki unchi zameen ki lambi patli patti; teesra - us unchi patti ke dakshin me faila hua neeche wala vishal kshetra; tatha chautha - Bihar subdivision. Pehle teen kshetra Bankipore, Barh tatha Dinapore subdivision me shamil the. Har kshetra me krishi ki paristhiti alag-alag thi, isliye faslon tatha sinchai ki vyavastha bhi alag-alag thi. Exam point: jile me krishi ke char bade kshetra the - diara bhoomi, Ganga ke kinare ki unchi patti, uske dakshin ki nichli bhoomi tatha Bihar subdivision; pehle teen Bankipore, Barh aur Dinapore me the.

qe: Which lands of the district were described as the most fertile, growing bhado crops before the river rises and rabi crops in the cold weather?
qh: जिले की कौन-सी भूमि सबसे उपजाऊ बताई गई, जो नदी बढ़ने से पहले भदोई फ़सल तथा जाड़े में रबी फ़सल देती थी?
oe: The hilly country of the Bihar subdivision
The diara lands in the bed of the Ganges
The upland strip north of the railway line
The tal lands of the Barh subdivision
oh: गंगा के पाट में बनी दियारा भूमि
रेलवे लाइन के उत्तर की ऊँची पट्टी
e: Diara bhoomi Ganga ke pattal me banti hai tatha jile ke poore uttar ki or phaili hui hai. Jab nadi apna marg badalti hai to yah bhoomi banti tatha nash bhi hoti rehti hai. Jahan geeli mitti jama hoti hai, wahan diara ki mitti bahut upjau hoti hai tatha shandar fasalein hoti hain; lekin yadi nadi marg badalne se doosre charan me bhi baadh ka paani ispar nahi chadhta, to yah sandy tatha banjar reh jaati hai. Isi karan diara bhoomi jile me sabse upjau maani gayi, jahan nadi badhne se pehle bhadoi fasal tatha jade ke mausam me rabi fasal achhi hoti thi. Exam point: Ganga ke pattal ki diara bhoomi sabse upjau thi, jahan nadi badhne se pehle bhadoi tatha jade me rabi fasal hoti thi; baadh ka paani na pahunchne par yahi bhoomi sandy tatha banjar ho jaati thi.

qe: In the upland tract, rice was cultivated only in some places, especially in the neighbourhood of which canal between Khagaul and Dinapore?
qh: ऊँची पट्टी वाले क्षेत्र में धान केवल कुछ स्थानों पर होता था, विशेषकर खगौल तथा दानापुर के बीच किस नहर के आस-पास?
e: Doosra krishi-kshetra Ganga ke sthayi kinare tatha dakshin ki nichli bhoomi ke beech ki unchi zameen ki lambi patli patti thi. Is kshetra me East Indian Railway line ke uttar ki saari zameen shamil thi, sirf ek chhoti si jagaah chhod kar, jo sabse pashchim-uttar me thi tatha barsaat me paani se bhar jaati thi. Yahan mukhyatah bhadoi tatha rabi fasalein hoti thi; dhani ki kheti bhi kuch jagah hoti thi, visheshkar Patna-Gaya Canal ke aas-paas Khagaul tatha Dinapore ke beech. Is tarah sinchai ki uplabdhata se hi naye kshetra me dhani jaise zyada paani wali fasal ugayi ja sakti thi. Exam point: unchi patti me mukhyatah bhadoi tatha rabi fasal hoti thi, jabki dhani Patna-Gaya Canal ke aas-paas Khagaul tatha Dinapore ke beech ugayi jaati thi.

qe: A canal running for about forty miles near the western border of the district supplied the whole of which thana, along with parts of the Maner, Dinapore, Phulwari and Masaurhi thanas?
qh: जिले की पश्चिमी सीमा के पास लगभग चालीस मील तक बहने वाली नहर किस पूरे थाने को तथा मनेर, दानापुर, फुलवारी और मसौढ़ी थानों के कुछ भागों को पानी देती थी?
e: Teesre krishi-kshetra ke pashchim bhag me sinchai nahar se hoti thi, jo jile ki pashchim siima ke paas lagbhag chalees mile tak chalti thi. Yah nahar poore Bikram thane tatha Maner, Dinapore, Phulwari aur Masaurhi thanon ke kuch bhaagon ko paani deti thi. Iske aage pashchim me Punpun nadi tatha uski sahayak nadiyan Morhar aur Dardha kshetra ko kat ti thi; in nadiyon ka paani sinchai ke liye khoob use hota tha, lekin jab Ganga ka paani badhta tha to inka paani peeche dhakel diya jaata tha tatha zameen baadh me doob jaati thi. Is tarah nahar tatha nadi dono hi sinchai ke sadhan the, lekin dono ki seemayein bhi thi. Exam point: pashchim sima ke paas ki nahar poore Bikram thane tatha Maner, Dinapore, Phulwari aur Masaurhi thanon ke kuch bhaagon ko paani deti thi; aage Punpun, Morhar aur Dardha nadiyon ka paani sinchai me kaam aata tha.

qe: Besides the Punpun, which two affluents were largely used for irrigation, their waters being forced back and the land flooded when the Ganges rises?
qh: पुनपुन के अतिरिक्त कौन-सी दो सहायक नदियाँ सिंचाई के लिए बहुतायत में प्रयोग होती थीं, जिनका पानी गंगा बढ़ने पर पीछे धकेल दिया जाता था और ज़मीन डूब जाती थी?
oe: The Gandak and the Burhi Gandak
e: Teesre krishi-kshetra ke pashchim bhag me kshetra Punpun nadi tatha uski sahayak nadiyon Morhar tatha Dardha se kata hua tha. In nadiyon ka paani sinchai ke liye bahut use hota tha, kyunki inka bahav halka tha tatha paani kheton tak pahunchana saral tha. Lekin jab Ganga ka paani badhta tha, to in nadiyon ka paani aage nahi badh paata tha tatha peeche dhakel diya jaata tha, jisse aas-paas ki zameen baadh me doob jaati thi. Yah dikhata hai ki nadion par adharit sinchai ka labh tatha hani dono ek hi vyavastha se jude the - paani ki uplabdhata badhne par fasal achhi hoti thi, lekin baadh aane par wahi paani nuksan pahunchata tha. Exam point: Punpun ki sahayak nadiyan Morhar tatha Dardha sinchai me bahut kaam aati thi; Ganga ka paani badhne par inka paani peeche dhakel diya jaata tha tatha zameen baadh me doob jaati thi.

qe: In the third agricultural tract, the lands of the Barh subdivision subject to annual inundation from the Punpun and other rivers meandering from west to east were known by what name?
qh: तीसरे कृषि-क्षेत्र में बाढ़ अनुमंडल की वे भूमियाँ, जो पश्चिम से पूर्व की ओर बहने वाली पुनपुन तथा अन्य नदियों की सालाना बाढ़ से प्रभावित रहती थीं, किस नाम से जानी जाती थीं?
e: Teesre kshetra ka ek bada hissa Barh subdivision me tha, jo jile ke sabse purbi chhor se lekar Patna shahar ke dakshin tak phaila hua tha. Is patti ki bhoomi ko tal land kaha jaata tha, kyunki yah Punpun tatha anya nadion ki saalana baadh se prabhavit hoti thi; ye nadiyan apne marg par pashchim se purb ki or bahti hui Ganga me milti thi. Is poore kshetra me bhadoi tatha dhani ki fasal tulnatmak kam hoti thi, lekin rabi ki fasal aam taur par achhi hoti thi. Purb ki or Mokameh thane ka ek hissa aisa bhi tha jahan Bihar subdivision jaisi sinchai-vyavastha banayi gayi thi. Exam point: Barh subdivision ki baadh-grast bhoomi tal land kehlati thi; yahan bhadoi tatha dhani kam hoti thi, lekin rabi ki fasal achhi hoti thi tatha Mokameh thane ke ek bhaag me Bihar subdivision jaisi sinchai-vyavastha bani.

qe: The reservoirs called ahars in the Bihar subdivision were, in some cases, filled with rain-water and natural drainage, and in others they were replenished by what means?
qh: बिहार अनुमंडल के अहर नामक जलाशय कुछ स्थानों पर वर्षा के पानी तथा प्राकृतिक निकास से भरते थे, और अन्य स्थानों पर उन्हें किस उपाय से भरा जाता था?
oe: By canals drawn from the Ganges
By wells dug in their beds
By water lifted from the Sone by pumps
oh: गंगा से निकाली गई नहरों से
उनके तल में कुएँ खोद कर
सोन से पंप द्वारा पानी उठा कर
e: Bihar subdivision me krishi-kshetra do bhaagon me tha - dakshin me pahadi tatha uttar me neeche wala maidan. Poora subdivision aisi nadion se kata hua tha, jinme garmi tatha jade ke mausam me paani kam ya bilkul nahi hota tha, lekin bhaari varsha hone par woh kinare-kinare bhar jaati thi. Isliye yahan paani ko sambhal kar baantne wali sinchai-vyavastha banayi gayi. Ahar naam ke jalashay banaye gaye; kuch varsha ke paani tatha prakritik nikaas se bharte the, jabki anya nadion par bandh bana kar bhare jaate the. Nadion se jalashyon tak tatha wahan se kheton tak chhoti-chhoti nahrein ya channels khodi gayi thi, jinse zyadatar kshetra sukhla se hone wale fasal-naash se bacha rehta tha. Exam point: ahar jalashay kuch jagah varsha-jal tatha prakritik nikaas se bharte the tatha kuch jagah nadion par bandh bana kar; chhoti nahrein paani nadion se aharon tak tatha wah se kheton tak pahunchati thi.

qe: Two areas of the Bihar subdivision were exceptions to the general protection from failure of crops by drought: the south-east corner of the Bihar thana and which thana of 116 square miles in the extreme south-west?
qh: बिहार अनुमंडल के दो क्षेत्र सूखे से फ़सल खराब होने की सामान्य सुरक्षा के अपवाद थे: बिहार थाने का दक्षिण-पूर्वी कोना तथा सुदूर दक्षिण-पश्चिम का 116 वर्ग मील का कौन-सा थाना?
e: Bihar subdivision ki sinchai-vyavastha zyadatar kshetra ko sukhla se hone wale fasal-naash se bachaati thi, lekin do kshetra iske apvad the - Bihar thana ka dakshin-purbi kona tatha sudoor dakshin-pashchim ka Islampur thana, jiska kshetra 116 square miles tha. Islampur thane me kushal sinchai-vyavastha bahut kam thi tatha Phalgu nadi, jo is thane se hokar guzarti hai, us samay tak sinchai ke liye taiyar nahi ki gayi thi. Is tarah ek hi subdivision ke andar kuch kshetra sinchai se surakshit the tatha kuch apvad bane rahe; isse pata chalta hai ki sinchai ki vyavastha sthal ki dhalan, nadion tatha varsha ke hisaab se hi banayi ja sakti thi. Exam point: Islampur thana (116 square miles) tatha Bihar thane ka dakshin-purbi kona sukhla-naash se surakshit karne wali sinchai-vyavastha ke apvad the; Islampur me Phalgu nadi se sinchai ki vyavastha nahi ban payi thi.

qe: The streams of the Bihar subdivision, unlike the rivers of the north, were described in what way during the hot and cold weather?
qh: बिहार अनुमंडल की नदियों के बारे में, उत्तर की नदियों से अलग, गर्मी तथा जाड़े के मौसम में क्या कहा गया?
oe: They dried up completely in every season
They contained little or no water, but were filled from bank to bank at the time of heavy rain
They flowed only during the cold weather
They always remained full of clear water
oh: वे हर मौसम में पूरी तरह सूख जाती थीं
उनमें पानी बहुत कम या बिल्कुल नहीं होता था, लेकिन भारी वर्षा के समय वे किनारे तक भर जाती थीं
वे केवल जाड़े के मौसम में बहती थीं
वे सदा साफ़ पानी से भरी रहती थीं
e: Bihar subdivision ki nadion ka svaroop uttar ki nadion se alag tha. Garmi tatha jade ke mausam me inme paani bahut kam ya bilkul nahi hota tha, lekin bhaari varsha ke samay yah kinare tak bhar jaati thi. Isi karan yahan paani ko rok kar jama karne tatha baantne wali vyavastha zaroori ho gayi, jisme ahar jalashay tatha nahron ka jaal shamil tha. Aise badalte svabhav wali nadion par khari rahne wali fasal (jaise dhani) lagana jokhim bhara tha, isliye log bhadoi tatha rabi fasalon par adhik nirbhar karte the. Iska ek udaharan Giriak ke paas bahti Panchanan nadi hai, jisme garmi ke mausam me paani kam hota tha. Exam point: Bihar subdivision ki nadiyan garmi tatha jade me lagbhag sookhi rehti thi tatha bhaari varsha me kinare tak bhar jaati thi; isi karan aharon tatha nahron ki sinchai-vyavastha zaroori thi.
